title: The pyrin inflammasome senses OCTN2-mediated uptake of extracellular ʟ-carnitine from muscle injury or ingestion
title_zh: 脓肿蛋白炎症小体感知肌肉损伤或摄入导致的OCTN2介导的细胞外L-肉碱摄取
abstract: Red-meat-containing diets are epidemiologically associated with diseases of chronic inflammation, while diets that restrict red meat improve health. Yet, it is uncertain how red meat incites inflammation. Here, we discover that ʟ-carnitine, an amino acid highly concentrated in skeletal muscle myocytes, drives inflammasome activation in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-challenged mice and LPS-primed murine and human macrophages. We find that extracellular ʟ-carnitine represses mevalonate synthesis, thereby triggering activation of the pyrin inflammasome, downstream of cellular import by the high-affinity ʟ-carnitine transporter OCTN2. We find that the inflammatory response to skeletal muscle injury also requires pyrin and OCTN2. Thus, in summary, we identify macrophages as sentinels of exogenous and endogenous extracellular ʟ-carnitine that serve as a proxy for skeletal myocyte damage, and we open the field to examine the mechanistic basis for how excess dietary intake of carnitine-rich food drives inflammatory disease.
abstract_zh: 红肉饮食在流行病学上与慢性炎症疾病相关，而限制红肉的饮食则能改善健康。然而，红肉如何诱发炎症仍不清楚。我们发现，L-肉碱——一种在骨骼肌细胞中高度浓缩的氨基酸——在脂多糖（LPS）挑战的老鼠以及LPS预处理的鼠类和人类巨噬细胞中驱动炎症小体激活。我们发现，细胞外L-肉碱抑制甲羟戊酸合成，从而触发脓肿蛋白炎症小体的激活，该过程位于高亲和力L-肉碱转运蛋白OCTN2的细胞内导入下游。我们还发现，骨骼肌损伤的炎症反应同样需要脓肿蛋白和OCTN2。因此，总结而言，我们将巨噬细胞确定为外源性和内源性细胞外L-肉碱的哨兵，它们作为骨骼肌细胞损伤的代理，并为研究过量摄入富含肉碱食物如何驱动炎症疾病的机制奠定了基础。
